The main takeaway from our work is that
the T and P measurement differences between radiosondes can be significant and should be taken into account when comparing coincident radiosonde measurements.
, in the presence of large T and P biases, frost point hygometers are more accurate than RS92 sondes for measuring RH, especially in the upper stratosphere.
